name: ezai-project-performance
description: Concurrency, async patterns, and performance optimization for Python and JS/TS projects: async/await, threading vs multiprocessing, profiling, streaming, and cancellation patterns.

capabilities.description: Choose between async/await, threading, and multiprocessing for I/O vs CPU-bound work
Profile before optimizing — identify bottlenecks first
Handle multi-GB files with generators or async iterables to prevent OOM
Implement timeouts, cancellable requests, and proper async cleanup
Tree-shaking, lazy loading, and bundler optimization for JS/TS
__slots__, lru_cache, NumPy, uvloop for Python performance
Limit concurrent operations with semaphores to prevent resource exhaustion
